fusions.name: Hauled Under
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Clamps on and tows it down: deals 22 damage and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Clamps on and rolls the target over. The roll deals 30 damage, plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Low in the Water
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you drift 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Held at Idle
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
